g.text: Headline pledges talk about justice; the strategies behind them talk less

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Each tick is one passage carrying that label, positioned by where it falls in the document and drawn one passage wide, so equal

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: ink means an equal share of the document. Both countries' current ANDCs are far denser in justice language than their own

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: long-term strategies — Türkiye 51.9% against 27.9%, Australia 45.2% against 29.1% — and procedural justice is the thinnest

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: strand nearly everywhere. Portugal's NBSAP is the exception: at 13.8% it is the most procedural document here bar one.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: All passage types included, not just body text, because the classifiers ran on every passage — much of the justice language in these documents sits in list items. Passages under 20 characters are dropped.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: The NDC-to-strategy gap is not purely rhetorical positioning: ANDCs are short political documents (54 and 155 passages here) while LT-LEDS are long technical ones (463 and 2,697), carrying inventory tables and sectoral detail that dilute any single theme. Türkiye's NDC 3.0 is 54 passages, so one passage there moves its rate by 1.9 points.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: DOCUMENTS.passage_count is not usable as a denominator here: it is rolled up from the v1 passages table and overstates the real v2 count 7-11x for these documents.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Source: Climate Policy Radar, PRODUCTION.PUBLISHED.PASSAGES (Snowflake), Aug 2026.
